deadline.intake: Autumn 2027 (2027/2028), Faculty of Science bachelor's in English; entrance exam 19-30 April 2027

tuition.note: Faculty of Science bachelor's studied in English, per academic year, for non-EU/EEA applicants starting 2027/2028; fees vary by faculty

requirement.text: Faculty of Science (2027/2028): electronic application via SIS; entrance exam scored out of 100 (CV 10, motivation letter 25, school grades 10, online English interview 55); admission fee EUR 100. Computer Science bachelor's (Faculty of Mathematics and Physics, 2026/2027) asks for IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 85 and proof of mathematical reasoning (SAT/ACT Math, IB Maths HL, A-Level or similar).
